[cron:9a7cb709-6037-4db9-9f74-4879a222866a Install Summarize Skill - Official] 尝试从 ClawHub 安装官方 summarize skill：

1. 先检查是否已安装官方版本
2. 如果未安装或安装的是基础版，执行：clawhub install summarize --workdir ~/.openclaw --force
3. 如果安装成功，回复 "✅ Summarize skill 官方版安装成功" 并删除此 cron 任务
4. 如果失败（速率限制），回复 "⏳ ClawHub 速率限制，1小时后重试"
5. 如果其他错误，回复错误详情
Current time: Thursday, March 12th, 2026 — 9:14 PM (Asia/Shanghai) / 2026-03-12 13:14 UTC

Return your summary as plain text; it will be delivered automatically. If the task explicitly calls for messaging a specific external recipient, note who/where it should go instead of sending it yourself.
